source.name: Elden Ring game files
source.note: Elden Ring data is read straight from the game files (patch 1.17.3, regulation 11730034, read 2026-10-22): hitboxes, cancel windows and hyper armor from the player animation events, damage from the game params. Poise damage and skill-buffed damage are not read yet. Move names follow the Elden Ring Frame Data Explorer by Emilia (sovietspaceship), and each move links to it for comparison.
